warnings: This runs the pack's own code, inside the sandbox, as soon as it loads. That is the point of the sandbox, and it is why the pack never goes near your live ComfyUI.
Nobody here has proved anything about this pack's safety. The notes come from reading its text. Being a pick does not make it safe, and a sandbox can have holes.
The sandbox has no internet, no GPU and no models, so it shows whether a pack loads and what nodes it adds. It will not render anything.
Its libraries are not installed for it. A pack that needs one you lack fails to load, and that is a real result.
